# Nintendo Switch 2 Welcome Tour Updated To Ver. 1.1.1, Here Are The Patch Notes

Just a little update

- by Liam Doolan
- 16 mins ago

 Image: Nintendo

Earlier this month, a major Switch 2 firmware update added VRR output to docked mode. This included an update to the game Welcome Tour, which now allows players to experience the "VRR Slider Demo" in TV mode.

Now, following this patch for Welcome Tour, Nintendo has released another update for the same game. Unfortunately, this time it doesn't detail what exactly has been improved, but we're guessing it's something connected to the previous game update. Here are the patch notes, according to Nintendo's official support page:

Subscribe to Nintendo Life on YouTube 852k

### Nintendo Switch 2 Welcome Tour: Ver. 1.1.1 (23rd September 2026)

General

- Several issues have been addressed to improve the gameplay experience.

As noted in the previous update for this game, the tech demo VRR Slider can be located in the Joy-Con 2 (L) Inner Area.

If you haven't already tested out VRR in docked, you may also be required to update your Switch 2 dock. You can do this by navigating to the Switch 2 settings and selecting the dock update option. You can find out more about Welcome Tour in our review here on Nintendo Life.

# Nintendo Switch 2 Welcome Tour: Update auf Version 1.1.1 erschienen

Redaktion

24. September 2026

Nintendo hat für Nintendo Switch 2 Welcome Tour das Update auf Version 1.1. 1 veröffentlicht. Es folgt auf ein größeres Update, mit dem Zelda: Ocarina of Time und Welcome Tour bereits VRR im TV-Modus unterstützen, eingeführt durch das System-Update auf Version 23.0.0.

## Patch Notes: Ver. 1.1.1 (24. September 2026)

Laut der offiziellen Nintendo-Support-Seite umfasst das Update lediglich folgenden Hinweis:

#### Allgemein

- Diverse Probleme wurden behoben, um das Spielerlebnis zu verbessern.

## VRR-Schieber-Demo im Joy-Con-2-Innenbereich

Wie bereits beim vorherigen Update erwähnt, lässt sich die Tech-Demo VRR-Schieber im Bereich „Joy-Con 2 (L): Innen“ finden. Wer VRR im Docked-Modus noch nicht getestet hat, muss unter Umständen zusätzlich die Nintendo Switch 2-Station aktualisieren.

## Ver. 1.1.0 (Veröffentlicht am 10. September 2026)

#### Allgemeines

- Die Tech-Demo VRR-Schieber in Joy-Con 2 (L): Innen kann nun im TV-Modus gespielt werden. 

- Um VRR-Schieber im TV-Modus zu spielen, ist ein VRR-kompatibler Fernseher erforderlich. Zudem muss die Nintendo Switch 2-Station aktualisiert werden.

# Blast off into high-octane adventure with added multiplayer content for Star Fox, available now on Nintendo Switch 2!

Close in on a free update for the Star Fox™ game—exclusively for the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system! But before you go blastin’ off in the Arwing, let’s take a look at the added content you can expect.

## New intel

- Battle Mode: Gather a crew of up to four players* in local split-screen Battle Mode!
- Three additional stages: Complete objectives in three more stages, Katina, Sector X, and Venom. 
- Battle online—together!: Up to four players can form a team and join online** battles using a single Nintendo Switch 2.

## Mission brief

Once widely regarded as a brilliant scientist in the Corneria Defense Force, Dr. Andross proclaimed himself emperor of the Lylat System. His treasonous actions exiled him to the remote planet Venom, where he now commands his forces in a ruthless mission to conquer the universe.
